data_description.name: Name of the plant.
data_description.moisture_entity_id: The sensor that provides the moisture level of the plant.
data_description.moisture_min: The threshold where the plant is too dry, if either the minimum or maximum is 0 this disables checking moisture.
data_description.moisture_max: The threshold where the plant is too wet, if either the minimum or maximum is 0 this disables checking moisture.
data_description.moisture_watering_increase: The amount that the moisture increases that indicates the plant has been watered and will automatically set the plant as watered (0 disables automatic watering detection).
